title: Pure Trickstar
summary: Trickstar cards only, with generic staples. Trickstar Candina searches any Trickstar card and burns for each Spell/Trap the opponent activates, while Lycoris, Narkissus and the Link Monsters add 200-point burns on every action. The 2025 wave leads and adds a Fusion side. Trickstar Hoody summons itself next to a Trickstar Fusion or Link Monster and searches Trickstar Fusion or Trickstar Diffusion when used for a Link. Diffusion Fusion Summons from the GY or Link Summons on the opponent's turn. Trickstar Band Drumatis searches a fresh Trickstar card, and Trickstar Noble Angel revives a Trickstar and destroys a card each time burn damage lands. Trickstar Aqua Angel also counts as Marincess and summons itself once per Duel. Noble Angel's search needs the separate Blue Tears cards, which this list doesn't run.
main: Trickstar Candina
Starter: searches any Trickstar card; burns for each of their Spells/Traps.
Trickstar Hoody
Newest: summons itself next to a Trickstar Fusion or Link; searches Trickstar Fusion or Diffusion.
Trickstar Aqua Angel
Newest: summons itself next to a Trickstar once per Duel; protects linked monsters in battle.
Trickstar Lilybell
Summons itself when added to the hand; attacks directly and recovers a Trickstar.
Trickstar Lycoris
Quick Effect: swaps in for a Trickstar on the field; burns for each card they add.
Trickstar Corobane
Summons itself on a Trickstar-only field; doubles a Trickstar's ATK in battle.
Trickstar Narkissus
Summons itself after they take effect damage; burns on their hand and GY effects.
Trickstar Mandrake
Summons itself when discarded; as Link Material, destroys a linked monster.
Trickstar Nightshade
Returns from the GY after being used for a Trickstar Link.
Trickstar Rhodode
Discards a Trickstar to revive a Trickstar Link.
Trickstar Light Stage
Field Spell: searches a Trickstar monster and locks a Set card.
Trickstar Fusion
Fusion Summons a Trickstar; recovers one from the GY.
Trickstar Festival
Two Trickstar Tokens for an immediate Link; shields an Extra Deck Trickstar.
Trickstar Diffusion
Newest Trap: Fusion Summons from the GY or Link Summons on their turn.
Trickstar Reincarnation
Replaces their whole hand; revives a Trickstar from the GY.
extra: Newest Fusion: searches a Trickstar card; zeroes a monster's ATK on burn.
Newest Link-2: revives a Trickstar and destroys a card on burn.
Newest Link-1: burns for the ATK of a monster destroyed in battle.
Link-2: protects the Trickstars it points to and burns on each summon.
Fusion: doubles a linked Link's burns.
Link-2: shrinks their monsters on each burn.
Link-2: discards a Trickstar to draw.
Link-3: burns per card and replaces itself with a Trickstar Link.
Link-4 finisher: burns per Trickstar name in the GY.
